Lemma
[Convex functions are locally Lipschitz] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0446, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0447, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0448 ↗ def:chow-iii-h20-convex-function 1. apph:H.21\group Convex functions

Every convex function on a connected locally convex set is locally Lipschitz, and therefore continuous, on the interior.
